integrity: Complete analytic classification of the exact idealized finite-dimensional model, supplemented by a standalone computational checker; no claims about physical field performance or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Three identical well-mixed compartments on one path, fixed symmetric inter-room exchange and baseline removal, constant source at one endpoint, receptor only at the other endpoint.
Additional sink-rate budget is continuous, linearly priced, and stationary, not discrete purifier devices.
No transient exposure, airflow reaction, source uncertainty, mixed room volumes, nonlinear removal, or field calibration.
Historical priority is based on inspected primary text and mathematical searches, without independent external audit.
title: A sharp middle-room activation threshold for end-to-end air cleaning on a three-room path
